name: Østerman-innspill
source: designed from the NTHF text (no puck.no picture); PROPOSED, for the user's review
text: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward in the slot, turns 180 degrees counterclockwise, stops, spins back and sends the puck in to the center
note: User review 2026-11-27 (Lindahl-innspill, applied to every centre that takes a pass from the right wing): the centre receives with its back to the right wing, which gives the most area to catch the puck.
